focus_area_title: Show Your Employees You Want the Best for Them
content_text_body:
Maintaining a work environment where employees feel appreciated and supported is an essential element in positive organizational cultures. Building genuine and caring relationships with employees shows them that they are a vital part of the company and their growth is a company matter.

After reflecting on the main areas of influence, your goal is to develop and/or maintain behaviors that can help you strengthen your connections with your employees and show them that you care about their well-being. 

### Connect 
Schedule time to connect with your employees and learn more about them as individuals- including their lives outside work (e.g. learn what is sparking their interest, their passions, their short-term and long-term plans). 

### Support 
Offer resources that can help them move forward with their plans or overcome challenges (e.g. mentorship sessions, flexible schedule, project rotations, skill-building trainings).  

### Show Appreciation 
Gestures of gratitude can make a great difference in your team dynamics (e.g. send an email thanking them for a specific contribution, give them a note encouraging them to keep up the good work). Employees like to be recognized for their work. 
 
Lastly, read this [article](https://hbr.org/2017/08/5-questions-to-help-your-employees-find-their-inner-purpose) to learn more on how to better connect with your employees by discovering their goals and motivations.
